'''Boleb Hiiz''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]. He served as [[Tirgee Benyalle]]'s [[Casino/Legends|casino]] administrator and [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kaal/Legends|Kaal]].
